notes: Exports were landing in plain Downloads under a name like cc18a2ea-6761-4a14-945b-be74e5b4c2eb.zip instead of in your folder. When no folder has been chosen the archive went through Chrome, and Chrome asks every extension that handles downloads about every download - one of them answering "no opinion" is still an answer, and it throws away the name we asked for, folder and all. That contest cannot be won.

So a run now refuses to start until you have chosen a folder in Settings, and says so before you pick anything rather than after. Choosing Through Chrome downloads deliberately still works, with the trade spelled out.
